description.value: McDonald's is a globally recognized fast food chain offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. This Surrey location on 160 Street includes drive-through service, making it a quick and accessible pit stop for cyclists on the go. As part of a large chain with broad menu options, it provides a reliable refueling option along a busy suburban corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record confirms a McDonald's fast food restaurant at 9638 160 Street, Surrey, with drive_through=yes and takeaway=yes tags. The website content is the national McDonald's Canada homepage (mcdonalds.ca) and contains no location-specific information for this Surrey outlet, so no amenity details beyond what OSM provides can be confirmed. The chain is clearly operational based on the active national website and no closure indicators.
concerns: OSM source data dates from City of Surrey 2010 GIS Data — location details (address, layout) have not been independently verified against a current location-specific page.
Website URL resolves to the national McDonald's Canada homepage only; no location-specific page was available to confirm amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or bike parking for this outlet.
No phone number present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational McDonald's franchise at a confirmed Surrey address with active national website; a reliable food and drink stop for touring cyclists.
